subject.title: fix(control-ui): add tooltips for Reasoning and Thinking dropdowns (#90445)

question: Should the Sessions details panel ship these provider-neutral Thinking and display-oriented Reasoning tooltips as a standalone partial fix while broader naming, inheritance, Quick Settings, and documentation work remains open?
rationale: The linked canonical issue is explicitly marked as needing a product decision, and accepting this partial wording establishes user-facing terminology before the broader surfaces are resolved.

options.title: Approve Sessions-only scope
options.body: Accept the focused tooltip approach after locale repair, conflict resolution, and browser proof, while keeping the canonical issue open for remaining surfaces.

options.title: Coordinate the full terminology change
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose names and explanations that can be applied consistently across Sessions, Quick Settings, inheritance semantics, and documentation.

recommendation.title: Approve Sessions-only scope
recommendation.body: Accept the focused tooltip approach after locale repair, conflict resolution, and browser proof, while keeping the canonical issue open for remaining surfaces.
